root.3.0.0.text: BUT THE DESKS CARRY NO FFMPEG

root.3.0.1.text: By design: no ffmpeg and no C or C++ tools on the desks. The first recorder design wrote through an ffmpeg subprocess, so on a desk it could not record.

root.2.1.text: comp.record.start rc 10: expected absolute path to a VFL directory; path without .vfl extension. Auto mode fell back to stills.

root.3.1.text: Fallback kept the episode working, so nothing looked broken. Every night since the recorder shipped. 19 November: 4 of 4 takes fell back to stills.
